title: AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator
codeSnippet:
class AgentOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, rag_engine, tools):
        self.rag = rag_engine
        self.tools = tools
        self.agents = [ResearchAgent(), CodeAgent(), QAAgent()]
    
    async def execute_task(self, prompt: str) -> ExecutionResult:
        # 1. Retrieve domain context via Vector RAG
        context = await self.rag.retrieve_top_k(prompt, k=5)
        # 2. Plan and delegate to specialized subagents
        plan = await self.agents[0].create_plan(prompt, context)
        return await self.dispatch_parallel(plan)
desc: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent subagent delegation, dynamic tool execution, and automated QA pipelines.

title: Media Lakehouse & ETL Platform
codeSnippet:
with DAG(dag_id="media_medallion_pipeline", schedule="@daily", catchup=False) as dag:
    # Bronze: Raw Ingestion via Distributed Scraper
    scrape_raw = PythonOperator(task_id="scrape_news_bronze", python_callable=scrape)
    # Silver: Cleansed & Normalized Delta Parquet
    clean_silver = SparkSubmitOperator(task_id="transform_silver", conn_id="spark")
    # Gold: Aggregated Analytics Warehouse
    load_gold = PostgresOperator(task_id="aggregate_gold_warehouse", sql="load.sql")
    scrape_raw >> clean_silver >> load_gold
desc: Distributed Big Data platform for ingesting, transforming, and visualizing media news articles using a Medallion Lakehouse architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) with Airflow scheduling.
